 Angered over a.m. WNBA Finals Game 6 tip-off, Chicago bar owner opens early to fans anyway
 Nora McConnell-Johnson, owner of Babe's Sports Bar, says the 11:30 a.m. weekday tip-off hurts "the momentum of women's sports." Her bar is open early Thursday to host fans, with coffee and a coworking space.
